changes: Scrolling scenes and status panels on original Game Boy games now keep their tile rows lined up more reliably; the focused raster check improved by 2.03%.
Monochrome games running on Game Boy Color keep vertical scrolling and mid-frame colour changes in the correct phase, reducing shifted or torn effects.
Wave-channel mute behavior is corrected, helping prevent stale clicks and low-frequency tails when games turn that channel down.
Measured host headroom is up by 23.83% in a DMG run and 14.07% in a GBC run, while game speed and frame checksums stay unchanged.
The regression suite is green (73/73), with production-model acceptance at 66/66 applicable checks and no timeouts.
The portable one-file build includes the supplied legal BIOS files, library artwork, saves, and the same emulator core.
